name: Fishing Journal and Trophies
description: The journal, fish sizes, notes, displays and the satchel.

pages.title: Fishing Journal and Trophies
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- The **Fishing Journal** fills a page for each new fish you catch.
- Every caught fish has a **length**; the journal keeps your biggest and smallest.
- **Fishy Notes** show a fish's page before you catch it.
- Mount fish on a **Fish Display**.

Lost the journal? Craft one from any fish and a book. It also works on a lectern.\
\
Uncaught fish are black outlines. A page shows where and when the fish bites (biome, depth, time, weather, moon, season, temperature), then how many you've caught, when, and your record sizes.

A fish caught alive can go in a bucket: combine it with a water bucket in your inventory (lava fish need a lava bucket). The length stays with it.\
\
Fill half the journal for **Aquatic Archivist**, all of it for **A Reel Completionist**.

pages.title: Fishy Note
pages.text: Every crate holds one, usually for a fish you haven't found. Or craft any fish with paper. Right-click to see that fish's page.

pages.title: Fish Display
pages.text: Sticks around a log. Hang it on a wall and right-click with a fish to mount it, shown at its real size. Empty hand takes it back.

pages.title: Fish Satchel
pages.text: 4 leather around a fish. Right-click to open it; while open, fish you pick up go straight in. Holds 64 fish.
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Aquaculture's fish mounts still work for its fish. Every caught fish carries its own length, so fish of different lengths don't stack.
